checks.name: LCP <= 2.5s on mobile
INP <= 200ms on mobile
CLS <= 0.1 on full page lifecycle
TTFB <= 800ms
Above-the-fold hero image has fetchpriority='high'
Modern image formats (AVIF / WebP) used
Images and iframes have explicit width/height or aspect-ratio
Brotli or Gzip compression enabled on text assets
Cache-Control immutable for static assets (max-age=31536000)
Total initial JavaScript bundle <= 180 KB gzipped
Root html element has valid lang attribute
Text color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 (normal) / >= 3:1 (large)
Non-text UI contrast >= 3:1 on form borders and icons
All meaningful images have descriptive alt text
Decorative images have empty alt='' and aria-hidden='true'
Interactive touch targets >= 48x48px on mobile
Form inputs have associated <label> or aria-label
Focus rings visible on keyboard navigation (:focus-visible)
Skip-to-content link provided as first tab element
Page zoom up to 200% does not break functionality or clip
Canonical link tag present and self-referential
Title tag 50-60 characters with primary intent keyword
Meta description 120-155 characters with action CTA
Exactly one <h1> tag per page
Open Graph (og:title, og:image 1200x630, og:description) present
Twitter card set to summary_large_image
Schema.org JSON-LD structured data valid and rich snippet eligible
Robots.txt exists and does not block critical assets
XML sitemap exists, submitted, and contains clean 200 OK URLs
Zero broken internal links or 301 redirect chains
HTTPS enforced with valid TLS certificate
Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header present
Content-Security-Policy (CSP) configured
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff present
X-Frame-Options set to DENY or SAMEORIGIN
Cookies have Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes
Zero mixed content (HTTP resources on HTTPS page)
Cookie consent banner compliant with GDPR/ePrivacy
Viewport tag configured with scalable user zoom
Form inputs have font-size >= 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom
Zero horizontal overflow / side-scrolling bugs
Sticky checkout or CTA bar present on mobile product pages
Verified trust seals and payment guarantees visible above the fold
5-second value proposition clarity (headline + benefit + CTA)
Safe area insets accommodated for iPhone home indicator
